sentences.text:
Chowdhuri Md. Aziz Hussain & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal
& Ors on 13 September, 2023

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
September 13, 2023
 Ardr (20)
 Wpa 14896 of 2023
 Chowdhuri Md. Aziz Hussain & ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & ors.
 Adv. S. P. Lahiri,
 Adv. Md. Habibur Rahman,
 ...for the petitioners.
 Adv. S.K. Tiwari,
 ...for the Uoi.
 Adv. Ayan Banerjee,
 ...for the State.
Affidavit of service filed by the petitioners is taken on  record.
Heard learned counsels for the parties.
It is contended on behalf of the petitioners that

their land was acquired by the State respondents vide L.A. case no. 19/NH/2004-2005 and notice under Section 12(2) of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 was issued to them, no further communication was made to them by the authority for payment of compensation.
The petitioners submitted a representation before the concerned authority ventilating their grievance on 12/13 th October, 2020 which is yet to be considered.
The petitioners pray for a direction upon the authority to consider the representation at the earliest.
It is submitted on behalf of the respondents that the 4th respondent be directed to consider the representation in accordance with law.

In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 4th respondent to consider and dispose of the representation submitted by the petitioner dated 12/13 th October, 2023 within six weeks from the date of communication of this order upon affording reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the stakeholders including the petitioners, in accordance with law.
